lines.t: I was spiraling down, lost in the static
Searching for a fix, yeah, it felt programmatic
Heartbeat cold, like a ghost in the attic
Then You walked in, made it all charismatic
I don't need a pill, I don't need a temporary
Your Word is the only thing that's necessary
Taking all the pain and the weight I carry
Turning every 'no' into 'visionary.'
I was sinking low, You were reaching out
You’re the only name that I’m gonna shout.
You’re the medicine, You’re the only remedy
Healing every scar, killing every enemy
When the world gets loud, You’re the symphony
Your grace is the only thing that’s curing me!
(Oh-oh-oh, You’re the medicine)
(Oh-oh-oh, You’re the cure for me)
[Verse 2]
(Snap-heavy trap beat)
Check it—
I was blind to the light, now I see the design
Every broken branch grafted into the Vine
It’s a heart transplant, it’s a miracle sign
I was lost in the dark till You made me shine
No more side effects, no more living in the past
Found a love so deep, found a love that’s gonna last.
One touch and the fever breaks
One word and the mountain shakes
I’m alive, I’m wide awake!
You’re the medicine, You’re the only remedy
Healing every scar, killing every enemy
When the world gets loud, You’re the symphony
Your grace is the only thing that’s curing me!
(Oh-oh-oh, You’re the medicine)
(Oh-oh-oh, You’re the cure for me)
You’re the medicine.
You’re the medicine.
The Way, the Truth...
(Fade out)
